about: Guidance evals for the VDI MCP engine. Each question is answered by calling the tool an agent would call; it passes if the expected guidance is in the result (expected rule ids in the top results, and/or expected phrases). Written 2026-11-23 from the AX lessons; deterministic, no API key.
